svg.text: Runtime portability: one contract, three backends, zero package changes
Decision semantics live in the PromptContract, not in any vendor SDK. Swapping the agent runtime is an environment variable, and the journal proves the behavior held.
PromptContract (shared)
One canonical assembly of what an agent step is:
instructions + subject record (with evidence) + cited
context from the IQ federation + tool definitions +
output expectations and confidence calibration.
Every adapter consumes this contract verbatim, so a
backend swap can never silently change what a
decision means
AGENT_BACKEND=agent-framework · ACTIVE in production today
Microsoft Agent Framework 1.13 (Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI): ChatClientAgent over the key-authenticated Azure OpenAI
client; MCP tools bridged as AIFunctions that journal every call; sessions per run.
Verified live: full claim run 4/4 steps GROUNDED with all three IQ systems cited, including the Fabric Data Agent.
new ChatClientAgent(chatClient.AsIChatClient(), instructions, name, description, tools)
AGENT_BACKEND=foundry · prepared, one grant away
Azure AI Foundry Agent Service: project adp-v1 created on aif-adp-v1, FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT already staged on the
container. The agents data plane requires Entra RBAC (api-key is rejected by design), so the flip waits on an Azure AI User
grant from the subscription admins. After the grant:
az containerapp update -n ca-tracesapi -g rg-adp-v1 --set-env-vars AGENT_BACKEND=foundry
AGENT_BACKEND=legacy · the fallback that stays honest
Direct Azure OpenAI chat completions on the same contract. Kept alive as the rollback path and as proof that the platform's
value (grounding, gates, journal, record) does not depend on any one agent SDK
A lesson this diagram encodes
Azure.AI.OpenAI 2.1 chat calls crash against the
OpenAI 2.10 assembly Agent Framework resolves
(MissingMethodException in PostfixSwapMaxTokens).
New direct chat-completion code (like evidence
vision) therefore calls the Azure OpenAI REST API
over HttpClient. Paid for in two deploys
THE TEST THAT MATTERS
Run the same subject on two backends and diff the journals: same grounding, same gate behavior, same decision shape. That is what "portable" means here.
